title: Derived reduction modulo varpi^n is left adjoint to restriction of scalars
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ and a scheme $Y$, and let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\twoheadrightarrow(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the reduction map of the completed coefficient sheaf on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}_n:\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Since $\operatorname{Res}_n$ is exact [lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact], applying it termwise defines a triangulated functor $\operatorname{Res}_n:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$. Let $-\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ be the derived tensor product with $(A_{E,n})_Y$ over $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$, computed with K-flat resolutions [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Then $-\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$ is left adjoint to $\operatorname{Res}_n$: there are bijections

$$
 \Hom_{D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n},M\bigr)
 \cong
 \Hom_{D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)}\bigl(K,\operatorname{Res}_nM\bigr),
$$

natural in $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $M\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$, whose unit is the map $K\to\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$ induced by $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\to(A_{E,n})_Y$.
